title: Fake-DOM piece 5: move task-chat-flight-companion-sentinel-mask and chart-helpers onto loadWorld
description:
Piece 5 of LIN-4271's approved plan. **Blocked on piece 0** (chart-helpers needs `getElementById`, `replaceChildren`, `createElementNS`, and the click helper).

### Slice of the approved plan

| path | tests | API |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `tests/unit/task-chat-flight-companion-sentinel-mask.test.js` | 21 | none missing (`public/task-chat.js:16-45`, `:190-216`, `:303-437`) |
| `tests/unit/chart-helpers.test.js` | 28 | `getElementById` (`public/chart-helpers.js:103`), `replaceChildren` (`:142`), `createElementNS` (`:179`) |

Fake-internals replacements, each proven red under its mutation:

* `sentinel-mask`: `savedList.children[0].innerHTML` (a tautological echo) becomes the `.task-chat-saved-meta`/`-title` text plus an `outerHTML` with no sentinel. Mutations: drop the mask at `task-chat.js:202`, `:203` or `:69`.
* `chart-helpers`: `canvas.replacedBy` becomes "the container has one child with the empty-state text, and `canvas.isConnected === false`". Mutation: delete `canvas.replaceWith(empty)` (`chart-helpers.js:109`). "Cells are text, not markup" (test `:231-234`) was vacuous before, and must now fail if the client used `innerHTML`.
* **Review note 2:** `chart-helpers.test.js:142-186` reads `svg.tag` and `svg.attrs[...]`, and `:287-297` calls `.click()` on buttons (the shared fake has no `element.click()`). Map them to `localName`, `getAttribute` and piece 0's click helper. Add each to the PR's assertion table with its mutation. `viewBox` case follows whatever piece 0 decided for namespaced attribute names.

Both ports are agent-reported only. This PR re-proves them.

**Rules for every move PR (from the plan):**

* Test names and counts stay the same. Before you touch a file: `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file> | sed -E 's/ \([0-9.]+ms\)$//' > before.txt`. After: the same into `after.txt`. Paste the empty `diff before.txt after.txt` and the pass counts into the PR. The counts must equal the plan's table.
* Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (`tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js:51`) **and** add it to the consumer paragraph in the `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` header, in the same PR (LIN-4265 comment `b6dfed3e`).
* Delete both copies in each suite: its own `FakeElement`/`FakeClassList` (or object-literal stubs) and its own `makeSandbox`/`load`/`vm.createContext`. Use `createFakeDom`/`loadWorld` (`tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js`).
* Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals. Map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards (the plan's "Fake-internals assertions" section). A replacement that cannot go red is a loosening and does not count.
* Every red that a real tree raises is a finding. The PR records each one as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Fix serializer differences (`disabled=""`, `hidden=""`, `checked=""`, escaping, parse errors on malformed markup or `<!doctype>`) in the test's regexes or fixtures, never by relaxing the fake.
* Never shim a missing shared-fake method in one file (no `doc.getElementById = …`). If you find a gap piece 0 missed, add it to `fake-dom.js` with its own `fake-dom.test.js` case, and say so on LIN-4271.
* LIN-4267/4268/4269 and the other pieces edit the same census list and header consumer paragraph. Before merge, update the branch against main and re-run CI on that head. `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` must be green on the merged head.
* Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js` (LIN-4272 files the follow-up), `select` support in the fake, and adding `style`/`getBoundingClientRect`/scroll/real event dispatch.

### Acceptance

* 21/21 and 28/28 pass with an empty name diff.
* Their own fakes and sandboxes are deleted.
* Both census entries are removed and both files are in the consumer paragraph.
* Every listed mutation is recorded red, including the SVG/click mappings.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: **LIN-4271**. Read its description's `## Implementation Plan` (the approved plan, read at `473cc865`) and its `### Plan Review Verdict` comment `db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e`, which has notes for the builder. Above that sit grandparent LIN-4255 and its course-change note `b4a44c2e-1ce0-4108-a524-eb94c3abfaee`. **The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts.** Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4271 (and on LIN-4255 if it changes the course-change note).

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4271's approving plan-review (comment db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e, rev 1)
* Grounding commit: `473cc865` (LinearViewer origin/main; the plan's read commit, still HEAD at breakdown on 2026-11-05, with no commits since to `tests/unit/helpers/`, the census, the fixture or the client files). Earlier beats read at `6d287518`.

---

### Implemented (close-out)

Implemented as approved by LIN-4271's plan, with no deviations: both suites are on `loadWorld`, with their private fakes and sandboxes deleted, and both are off the census list and in the `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph. PR: [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2309](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2309>), squash-merged as `48d93c5c`. The full pre-close description is preserved in the LIN-4284 task snapshots, and the history is in the comment trail.

comments.body:
**LIN-4284 beat 1/5 (ground, branch, baseline): done, no test or fake edits.**

- Branch: `feat/lin-4284-fake-dom-piece-5` from main `aeb9d877` (LIN-4279 merged). Not pushed, no PR yet.
- Staleness: commits since the ticket on the census, fake, and both client files are LIN-4268 (8369461c), LIN-4280 (82e75ee9) and LIN-4279 (aeb9d877). All are in the base and were read at HEAD.
- Baseline (node --test, ms stripped): sentinel-mask 21/21, chart-helpers 28/28. Matches the plan table. Files kept outside the repo.
- Piece-0 APIs at HEAD: getElementById, replaceChildren, createElementNS (SVG case kept), clickOn, localName, getAttribute, and viewBox case. Piece-1 world.run is also at HEAD. No shared-fake gap found for these two suites.
- Drift: none in counts or mutation line numbers. Note: the sentinel suite loads only task-chat.js (the flight-companion in its name is historical).
- Inventory (local, outside repo): ~/scratchpad LIN-4284-beat1-inventory.md, sections A (sentinel-mask) and B (chart-helpers), with each fake-internal read mapped to a replacement and its red mutation.
- Open for review: the sentinel suite keeps its slices, run through world.run (not window.TaskChat.init). The chart-helpers port adds two assertions (tagName/namespace, viewBox) that the plan does not list.

Next: beat 2 (ports).

**LIN-4284 (piece 5) implementation: PR up for review.** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2309 (head `74fa12fe`, not merged, not Done).

**What moved.** Both suites are on `loadWorld`. Their local `FakeElement`/`FakeClassList`, object-literal stubs and vm sandboxes are deleted.
- `task-chat-flight-companion-sentinel-mask.test.js`: source slices run with `world.run` into one world each; real nodes for the DOM; ChatUI, api, toast and appendBubble stay doubles.
- `chart-helpers.test.js`: `public/chart-helpers.js` runs in one `loadWorld` world, with `Chart` and `getComputedStyle` as globals; canvases are real elements in a container.

**Names and counts.** sentinel-mask 21/21 and chart-helpers 28/28, names unchanged. Against the baseline, only the spec reporter's suite-level `duration_ms` summary line differs.

**Mutation to red, condensed.**
- sentinel-mask (`task-chat.js`): M1 meta unmasked (:202) → companion-save test. M2 title unmasked (:203) → same test, title assertion. M3 pill `who` (:69) → resumed pill test. M4 resumed label (:274) → resume test. M5 send label (:320) → send test. M6 glyph write (:108) and M7 class swap → both setBubbleState tests. M8 idInput seeded (:259) → resume test. M9 mask unconditional → 8 red, every ordinary-task test.
- chart-helpers (`chart-helpers.js`): M1 `replaceWith` removed (:109) → empty-state test. M2 `createElementNS`→`createElement` (:179) → img-svg test (`tagName` 'SVG' vs 'svg'). M3 click listener (:157) → two rateTotalToggle tests. M4 destroy listener (:169) → destroy test. M5 cells via `innerHTML` (:233) → cells-as-text test. M6 `viewBox` key lower-cased (:190) → img-svg test (`getAttribute('viewBox')` null). M7 view not emptied (:142) → switch test.

**First-run reds:** none in either suite.

**Shared fake.** No additions were needed, so nothing changed in `fake-dom.js` or `fake-dom.test.js`. The census consumer paragraph in `fake-dom.js` gained the two suites.

**Tightened and added assertions.**
- Sentinel: meta and title are exact `textContent` (were `includes`); the raw-sentinel check reads `outerHTML`.
- Chart: `tagName`/`namespaceURI` and `getAttribute('viewBox')` are added inside the existing img-svg test. No new tests.

**Decisions.**
- Kept the source slices through `world.run` rather than loading all of `task-chat.js` and calling `TaskChat.init`, because the per-line mutations assume the slices.
- Non-DOM collaborators stay doubles.
- Merged `origin/main` into the branch rather than rebasing, matching LIN-4279. The only overlap was the census and the `fake-dom.js` header.

**Census.** Both files are off `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and in the consumer paragraph.

**CI on `74fa12fe`.** 7/7 SUCCESS: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success.

**Test totals on the merged head.** Census 43/43. Focused set 182/182. Full unit suite (`npm run test:unit`) 23744/23744.

**Out of scope, untouched.** The `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js` (LIN-4272); `select` in the fake; `style`, `getBoundingClientRect`, scroll and event dispatch; `flight-companion-client` (stays on the census).

**Autopilot (stepper) run summary — LIN-4284 implementation step.**

One warm worker session, five beats, all judged on evidence before advancing (ROOT `068d73f4`):
1. **Ground, branch, baseline** — branch `feat/lin-4284-fake-dom-piece-5` from main `aeb9d877`; baselines 21/21 and 28/28 matched the plan table; piece-0/1 APIs confirmed at HEAD; per-assertion mutation inventory written.
2. **sentinel-mask port** (`bd8aa733`) — 21 names unchanged; 9 mutations each shown red; full unit suite 23744/23744.
3. **chart-helpers port** (`b6723a7f`) — 28 names unchanged; 7 mutations each shown red; no shared-fake additions needed.
4. **Merge main, push, PR** — `origin/main` merged (`74fa12fe`); census 43/43 on the merged head; PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2309.
5. **Linear close-out** — summary comment on this ticket and a piece-5 report on LIN-4271.

**Independently verified by the orchestrator (not worker self-report):** PR #2309 OPEN, MERGEABLE, head `74fa12fe`; all 7 CI checks (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success) COMPLETED/SUCCESS on that head; the diff is only the two suites, `tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` and `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` — nothing under `public/`; both Linear comments present; ticket still In Progress.

**What holds:** names/counts preserved (only the spec reporter's suite-level `duration_ms` line differs); no pre-existing assertion weakened (sentinel meta/title tightened to exact `textContent`); no local shims.

**What's left:** independent `review`, then `close-out` (merge, ledger, Done). Not merged, not Done. Judgement calls for review to weigh: sentinel suite keeps source slices via `world.run` (the plan's per-line mutations assume them); collaborators stay doubles; two new chart assertions were added inside existing tests.

## Review — LIN-4284

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2309 at head `74fa12fe`. I also merged it locally onto current `origin/main` `d537cd69` (LIN-4267, which landed after the PR's last merge). That merge, `d15fb802`, was a clean auto-merge of the census and the `fake-dom.js` header.

CI: green on `74fa12fe`: 7/7 SUCCESS (Unit tests, E2E 1–4, Secret scan, CI success). No CI run yet on a head that includes `d537cd69`; see the ledger.

**Scope vs plan.** The diff is exactly the two suites, the census list (−2) and the `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph (+2). Nothing under `public/`, and no change to `fake-dom.js` or `fake-dom.test.js` beyond the header. No local shims: `grep FakeElement|FakeClassList|vm|createContext|runInNewContext` finds nothing in either suite.

**Re-run on the merged head (`d15fb802`):** sentinel-mask 21/21, chart-helpers 28/28, census 43/43. The test-name diff against base (`node --test --test-reporter=spec | sed` ms-strip, with the suite-level `duration_ms` line dropped) is **empty** for both files.

**Mutations, re-run independently.** Every mutation went red, and every source change was reverted afterwards.
| mutation | red test |
|--|--|
| task-chat.js meta unmasked (renderSavedRows `var meta`) | companion save renders both readable |
| task-chat.js title unmasked (`var title`) | same test |
| task-chat.js pill `who` unmasked (appendBubble) | resumed companion speaker pill |
| chart-helpers.js `canvas.replaceWith(empty)` deleted | swaps the canvas for the note |
| `createElementNS` → `createElement` | img svg test |
| `viewBox` key lower-cased | img svg test (`getAttribute('viewBox')`) |
| click `addEventListener` removed | both rateTotalToggle click tests |
| destroy `removeEventListener` removed | destroy() test (`listenersOf('click')`) |
| `td.textContent` → `td.innerHTML` | cells are text, not markup |
| `view.replaceChildren()` in `set` removed | switch empties the view |

The fake-internal reads are mapped to real-DOM reads that go red: `replacedBy` → container child + `isConnected`; `.tag`/`.attrs` → `localName`/`getAttribute`; `.click()` → `clickOn`; `innerHTML` echo → `.task-chat-saved-meta`/`-title` `textContent` + `outerHTML`. The "cells are text" test is no longer vacuous.

**Open questions from the brief, ruled on.**
- Keeping the sentinel suite's slices with `world.run`, rather than calling `TaskChat.init`, is accepted. The plan's table cites slice line ranges and the per-line mutations depend on them, so this is not a plan departure.
- The added `tagName`/`namespaceURI`/`viewBox` assertions are accepted. They sit inside the existing img-svg test, they make it stricter, the counts don't change, and the issue's review note 2 asks for the `viewBox` case explicitly.

**Regression check.** The PR touches no `public/` file. On the two suites, the only recent history is the original feature commits (LIN-3710/3732/2437/2445). There are no reverts to re-apply.

**One of a class?** These are the remaining siblings in the `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` census. LIN-4271 bounds them, and pieces 2–6 own them; none belongs to this piece. The work is isolated to this piece's two files. No rulings exist for LIN-4284.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (the ticket's own merge rule: "update the branch against main and re-run CI on that head"): CI has not run on a head that includes `d537cd69` (LIN-4267). LIN-4267 edits the same census list and header paragraph. My local merge of the two was clean, and on it census 43/43 and both suites passed, but I did not run the full unit suite or the E2E shards there. **Before the merge:** close-out updates the PR branch against main, waits for CI green on that new head, and confirms `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` passes there. If a sibling piece (LIN-4281/4282/4283/4285) merges first, update again.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The deliverable meets every acceptance criterion (21/21 and 28/28 with empty name diffs, private fakes and sandboxes deleted, census and consumer paragraph updated, every listed mutation red, which I re-ran myself). The only open item is CI on a branch updated against current main.

## Close-out — LIN-4284

**Merged.** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2309 was squash-merged as `48d93c5c`, pinned with `--match-head-commit d14ce0e3`. That is the exact commit CI passed on. It moved `task-chat-flight-companion-sentinel-mask` (21 tests) and `chart-helpers` (28 tests) onto `loadWorld`. Their private fakes and sandboxes are deleted, both files are off `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES`, and both are in the `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph.

**Changes I made after the review's Approve**
- `d14ce0e3`: merged `origin/main` (`d537cd69`, LIN-4267) into the PR branch. The merge was clean and had no conflicts. This answers the review's one ledger item (see below). I made no other change, and the diff against the reviewed head is only what LIN-4267 brought in. Nothing under `public/` changed.

**Ledger**
- *Inside: CI had not run on a head that includes `d537cd69`.* Settled. CI exists (`.github/workflows/test.yml`). On `d14ce0e3` all 7 checks are SUCCESS: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and CI success. Before merging I re-read the PR and confirmed that `origin/main` (`d537cd69`) was an ancestor of the head, that the head was `d14ce0e3`, and that the PR was MERGEABLE. Locally on that head, census 43/43, sentinel-mask 21/21 and chart-helpers 28/28 passed (92/92 total).
- *Outside:* none. The review's ledger had only this one item, so I filed no follow-ups. LIN-4272 (the `prompt-section.js` guards) already owns the one out-of-scope item the ticket names.
- *Named monitor or rollback:* the review named none, so none is needed.

**After the merge.** The change touches tests only (`tests/unit/**`), with nothing under `public/` and no runtime, so there is nothing to deploy. I verified on the merged commit `48d93c5c`: census, sentinel-mask and chart-helpers all pass, 92/92 and 0 failures.

**Final CI state:** 7/7 SUCCESS on `d14ce0e3`, merged as `48d93c5c`.

**Description:** I took the archive first, and the snapshot was verified in `/snapshots`. The description held no discharged plan, research or scoping sections, only the problem slice, rules and acceptance, so I kept it word for word and appended a short "Implemented" stub with the PR link. The full history is in the snapshots and this comment trail.

**Related tickets:** LIN-4271 (parent) stays open because pieces 2–4 and 6 are still in progress. LIN-4279, which blocks this ticket, is already Done.
